note: First version: the quiet accent text that opens or does something (Browse events, All meals, Clear)

component.doc: A quiet text link: accent Label text, padded 4 dp across and 8 dp down so it is easy to tap, that runs on_click. For a header's action in words rather than an icon, or a small action beside a list (Clear, See all). For a filled button use core://Button.

params.name: description
params.doc: What it does, for screen readers (often the label itself).

examples.note: a small action beside a section's heading
